question: Which Vista exports that this tree already builds should be visible at the current export version?
allowedInputs: dll/win32/kernel32/kernel32.spec IsThreadAFiber was already a real export behind a 0x600 gate
dll/ntdll/def/ntdll.spec NtCancelIoFileEx was already present as a stub behind a 0x600 gate
dll/win32/ws2_32/ws2_32.spec WSAPoll and WSASendMsg were already stubs behind a 0x600 gate
Reported: DLL_EXPORT_VERSION stays 0x502, so those gates hid the exports from the updater
